title: mlflow_artifacts example S3 storage: RustFS service plus one-shot AWS CLI bucket creation, gated by service_completed_successfully
answers: Why does the mlflow_artifacts docker-compose example fail with pull access denied for minio/mc?
How do I point the MLflow artifacts example's S3 endpoint at a different S3-compatible store in docker-compose?
How is the bucket created for the mlflow_artifacts example's artifact store?
Where is the artifact storage service and console port (9001) configured for the MLflow artifacts example?
body:
Path: examples/mlflow_artifacts/docker-compose.yml (services storage, create-bucket, and the mlflow server service) runs the tracking server with artifacts going to an S3-compatible store; the README's docker-compose section and test_mlflow_artifacts_example exercise this file.
Rule: Storage is the RustFS image pinned to rustfs/rustfs:1.0.0-alpha.83 and healthchecked via curl on /health. The bucket is created by a one-shot amazon/aws-cli:2.33.25 service that uses head-bucket then create-bucket against http://storage:9000, and the server service waits on it with condition: service_completed_successfully. MLFLOW_S3_ENDPOINT_URL must use the in-network service name (http://storage:9000), and AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY must match RUSTFS_ACCESS_KEY/RUSTFS_SECRET_KEY.
Symptom: The example's tests failed in CI because Docker could not pull minio/mc (Docker Hub returned 404 for that repository), so tests/tracking/test_mlflow_artifacts.py::test_mlflow_artifacts_example could not start the compose stack. The fix was to replace the MinIO and mc images, not to change MLflow code.
Constraints: Applies only to this example's compose file. Do not reintroduce minio/mc for bucket setup. The top-level compose `version:` key was dropped in this layout. The MLflow server code and the S3 artifact repository are unchanged by this example.
applies: Scope: the mlflow_artifacts example's docker-compose setup and its README; not the core MLflow artifact repository code.
says: The sample container walkthrough cannot start because the bucket setup image cannot be downloaded.
Our artifact storage tutorial crashes before starting due to an unpullable helper image.
Make the artifact storage sample initialize its cloud bucket with reliable container images.
Ensure the artifact server demo waits for bucket creation before starting services.
search: In examples/mlflow_artifacts/docker-compose.yml, artifact storage uses the rustfs/rustfs:1.0.0-alpha.83 service healthchecked on /health, with bucket creation handled by a one-shot amazon/aws-cli:2.33.25 service that runs head-bucket then create-bucket against http://storage:9000. The mlflow server service must wait on bucket creation using condition: service_completed_successfully, while MLFLOW_S3_ENDPOINT_URL points to http://storage:9000 and matching AWS and RUSTFS access keys and secret keys are supplied. This setup replaces minio and minio/mc images after 404 pull failures in test_mlflow_artifacts_example without modifying core MLflow artifact repository code. The rule applies only to this example compose setup and drops the top-level version key.
